sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, travel to face Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Sandbach come into the match on the back of a recent loss but maintain a strong record with seven wins from their last six outings before that setback. Alsager are bottom of the division with just four points and a run of five losses in their last six games, making this a significant opportunity for Sandbach to respond to their recent defeat.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host struggling Dawley Town on Saturday, looking to capitalize on a recent loss and maintain pressure on the leaders. AFC Bridgnorth entertain Eccleshall in a clash between two of the division's in-form teams—Eccleshall have won five of their last six while Bridgnorth also show recent improvement. Wolverhampton Casuals, on a three-game winning run and sitting fourth, face Wednesfield Community at home; this fixture is notable as it also features midweek when Brereton Social host Wednesfield on Wednesday 7 October. Bilston Town (fifth) are in strong form and host Foley Meir, while Barnton travel to meet Shawbury United in a battle between mid-table teams with contrasting recent form—Barnton have won two of their last three while Shawbury are on a run of six consecutive losses. Market Drayton Town, inconsistent with mixed recent results, visit New Mills. Crewe face Allscott Heath on Saturday, and Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a clash between two of the division's struggling sides. Finally, Brereton Social host Widnes Town on Saturday; Widnes remain winless with just two points from seven games.
